name: SelectMenu
description: Custom listbox select for rich options: descriptions, icons, groups, multi-select, custom rows and hidden inputs for forms.
designIntent: Native <select> cannot render rich option content. SelectMenu supplies a real listbox behind a select-only combobox trigger with the combobox/listbox keyboard model while keeping the same value/onValueChange contract as Select, so teams can move between the two without rewriting state.

props.name: items
props.description: Options: { value, label, description?, icon?, disabled?, group? }.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow several selections; the listbox stays open.

props.name: name
props.description: Renders hidden form inputs for the selected values.

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (item, state: { selected: boolean; active: boolean }) => ReactNode

examples.title: Rich options
examples.code:
<SelectMenu
  aria-label="Plan"
  placeholder="Choose a plan"
  items={[
    { value: 'free', label: 'Free', description: '1 project', group: 'Individual' },
    { value: 'team', label: 'Team', description: 'SSO + audit log', group: 'Business' },
  ]}
  value={plan}
  onValueChange={setPlan}
/>
examples.description: Descriptions and grouped headings inside a real listbox.

examples.title: Multi-select with form input
examples.code:
<SelectMenu
  aria-label="Channels"
  multiple
  name="channels"
  items={channels}
  value={selected}
  onValueChange={setSelected}
/>
examples.description: Hidden inputs make the selection submit with the form.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for free-text entry
antiPatterns.explanation: SelectMenu has no text input. Use Autocomplete when typing a value is expected.

antiPatterns.title: Don't render more than ~50 options
antiPatterns.explanation: There is no filtering. Large sets need Autocomplete or a searchable flow.

accessibility.implementation: Arrows move the active option, Home/End jump, Enter/Space select, Escape closes, typeahead jumps by first letters
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep option labels distinct so typeahead stays predictable

guidelines: Use description for the second line
badExamples: Click to pick the pro plan option

compositionRules.relationship: Prefer Select when options are plain text (native pickers, mobile UX)
